# Sequence diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-sequence/grammar/sequence.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Sequence diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `sequenceDiagram` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read as
`='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities kept as
opaque text that no rule takes apart; and a line break appended. Keywords are matched without
regard to case. A participant id and an invalid id lose the blanks around them.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is `sequenceDiagram`, then statements.

```ebnf
sequence = { nl } Header document ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = SD ;
```

Statements, separated by line breaks or `;`; blocks and titles need no separator.

```ebnf
document = { statement | nl | INVALID } ;
```

```ebnf
nl = NEWLINE
   | SEMI
   | ALIAS_END
   | EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Participant nl
          | Create nl
          | Message nl
          | Note nl
          | Activation nl
          | Autonumber nl
          | menu nl
          | Title
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | Box
          | fragment
          | Rect ;
```

`participant A`, `participant A as Alice` or `participant A@{ "type": "database" }`: declares
a participant, drawn as a box unless the data gives another type.

```ebnf
participantDecl = participant ACTOR [ config ] [ AS restOfLine ] ;
```

`actor A` or `actor A as Alice`: declares a participant drawn as a stick figure.

```ebnf
actorDecl = participant_actor ACTOR [ config ] [ AS restOfLine ] ;
```

`destroy A`: the participant ends at the next message, which comes from or goes to it.

```ebnf
destroyDecl = destroy actor ;
```

```ebnf
participantLine = participantDecl
                | actorDecl
                | destroyDecl ;
```

```ebnf
Participant @Participant = participantLine ;
```

`create participant A` or `create actor A`: the participant appears at the next message,
which goes to it.

```ebnf
Create @Participant = create participantLine ;
```

```ebnf
config = CONFIG_START CONFIG_CONTENT CONFIG_END ;
```

```ebnf
actor = ACTOR
      | link ;
```

`A->>B: text`; `+`/`-` after the arrow activate the target or deactivate the source, `()`
on either side of the arrow is a central connection.

```ebnf
Message @Message = actor ( arrow [ PLUS | MINUS | PARENS ] | PARENS arrow [ PARENS ] ) actor TXT ;
```

```ebnf
arrow = SOLID_ARROW
      | BIDIRECTIONAL_SOLID_ARROW
      | DOTTED_ARROW
      | BIDIRECTIONAL_DOTTED_ARROW
      | SOLID_OPEN_ARROW
      | DOTTED_OPEN_ARROW
      | SOLID_CROSS
      | DOTTED_CROSS
      | SOLID_POINT
      | DOTTED_POINT
      | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_DOTTED
      | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_DOTTED
      | STICK_ARROW_TOP_DOTTED
      | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_DOTTED
      | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE_DOTTED
      | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE_DOTTED
      | STICK_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE_DOTTED
      | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE_DOTTED
      | SOLID_ARROW_TOP
      | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM
      | STICK_ARROW_TOP
      | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM
      | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE
      | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE
      | STICK_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE
      | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE ;
```

`note left of A: text`, `note right of A: text` or `note over A,B: text`: a note beside
one participant or over one or two.

```ebnf
Note @Note = note ( ( left_of | right_of ) actor | over actor [ COMMA actor ] ) TXT ;
```

`activate A` / `deactivate A`: starts or ends an activation bar.

```ebnf
Activation @Activation = ( activate | deactivate ) actor ;
```

`autonumber`, `autonumber <start> [<step>]` or `autonumber off`: numbers the messages.

```ebnf
Autonumber @Autonumber = autonumber [ NUM [ NUM ] | off ] ;
```

```ebnf
menu = Links
     | Link
     | Properties
     | Details ;
```

`links A: {"label": "url"}`: menu links for a participant.

```ebnf
Links @Links = links actor TXT ;
```

`link A: label @ url`: one menu link for a participant.

```ebnf
Link @Link = link actor TXT ;
```

`properties A: {"key": "value"}`: properties for a participant's menu.

```ebnf
Properties @Properties = properties actor TXT ;
```

`details A: <element id>`: menu data read from a page element.

```ebnf
Details @Details = details actor TXT ;
```

`title <text>` or `title: <text>`: the diagram title.

```ebnf
Title @Title = title
             | legacy_title ;
```

`accTitle: <text>`: the accessible title.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: <text>` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

`box <colour> <label>` … `end`: groups the participants declared inside, with an optional
colour and label.

```ebnf
Box @Box = box restOfLine { Participant nl | nl } end ;
```

`loop <text>` … `end`: a repeated part.

```ebnf
Loop @Fragment = loop restOfLine document end ;
```

`opt <text>` … `end`: an optional part.

```ebnf
Opt @Fragment = opt restOfLine document end ;
```

`break <text>` … `end`: a part that ends the sequence.

```ebnf
Break @Fragment = break restOfLine document end ;
```

`alt <text>` … `else <text>` … `end`: alternative paths.

```ebnf
Alt @Fragment = alt restOfLine document { Else } end ;
```

`else <text>`: the next path of an `alt`.

```ebnf
Else @Section = else restOfLine document ;
```

`par <text>` … `and <text>` … `end`: parallel paths.

```ebnf
Par @Fragment = par restOfLine document { And } end ;
```

`par_over <text>` … `and <text>` … `end`: parallel paths drawn over each other.

```ebnf
ParOver @Fragment = par_over restOfLine document { And } end ;
```

`and <text>`: the next path of a `par` or `par_over`.

```ebnf
And @Section = and restOfLine document ;
```

`critical <text>` … `option <text>` … `end`: a critical region and its options.

```ebnf
Critical @Fragment = critical restOfLine document { Option } end ;
```

`option <text>`: the next option of a `critical` region.

```ebnf
Option @Section = option restOfLine document ;
```

```ebnf
fragment = Loop
         | Opt
         | Break
         | Alt
         | Par
         | ParOver
         | Critical ;
```

`rect <colour>` … `end`: a background highlight around its statements.

```ebnf
Rect @Rect = rect restOfLine document end ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `ID`, `ALIAS`, `LINE`, `CONFIG`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `\n+` |  | Separators: line breaks, `;` and the end of the text. |
| INITIAL | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| ID, ALIAS, LINE | — | `(?:(?!\n)\s)+` |  |  |
| INITIAL, ID, ALIAS, LINE | — | `#(?!\w+;)[^\n]*` |  | `#` to the end of the line is a comment outside messages and labels; an entity such as `#lt;` is text. |
| INITIAL | — | `%(?!\{)[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `[^}]%%[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NUM | `(?:[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?\|\.[0-9]{1,2})(?=[ \n]+)` |  | `autonumber 10 5`: the first number and the step. |
| ID | CONFIG_START | `@\{` | pop push(CONFIG) | Participant data `participant A@{ "type": "database" }`: YAML in braces. |
| CONFIG | CONFIG_CONTENT | `[^}]+` |  |  |
| CONFIG | CONFIG_END | `\}(?=\s+(?i:as)\s)` | pop push(ALIAS) |  |
| CONFIG | CONFIG_END | `\}` | pop |  |
| ID | ACTOR | `[^<>:\n,;@\s]+(?=\s*@\{)` |  | A participant id after `participant`, `actor`, `destroy`, `activate` and `deactivate`. |
| ID | ACTOR | `[^<>:\n,;@\s]+(?=\s+(?i:as)\s)` | pop push(ALIAS) |  |
| ID | ACTOR | `[^<>:\n,;@]+(?=\s*[\n;#]\|$)` | pop |  |
| ID | INVALID | `[^<>:\n,;@]*<[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| ID | INVALID | `[^\n]+` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | box | `(?i:box)\b` | push(LINE) | `box <colour> <label>`: groups the participants declared up to `end`. |
| INITIAL | participant | `(?i:participant)\b` | push(ID) | `participant A`, `participant A as Alice`: declares a participant (a box). |
| INITIAL | participant_actor | `(?i:actor)\b` | push(ID) | `actor A`: declares a participant drawn as a stick figure. |
| INITIAL | create | `(?i:create)\b` |  | `create participant A`: the participant appears at the next message, which goes to it. |
| INITIAL | destroy | `(?i:destroy)\b` | push(ID) | `destroy A`: the participant ends at the next message, which comes from or goes to it. |
| ALIAS | AS | `(?i:as)\b` | pop push(LINE) | `participant A as Alice`: the label shown for the participant. |
| ALIAS | ALIAS_END | `(?:)` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | loop | `(?i:loop)\b` | push(LINE) | `loop <text>` … `end`: a repeated part. |
| INITIAL | rect | `(?i:rect)\b` | push(LINE) | `rect <colour>` … `end`: a background highlight. |
| INITIAL | opt | `(?i:opt)\b` | push(LINE) | `opt <text>` … `end`: an optional part. |
| INITIAL | alt | `(?i:alt)\b` | push(LINE) | `alt <text>` … `else <text>` … `end`: alternative paths. |
| INITIAL | else | `(?i:else)\b` | push(LINE) | `else <text>`: the next path of an `alt`. |
| INITIAL | par | `(?i:par)\b` | push(LINE) | `par <text>` … `and <text>` … `end`: parallel paths. |
| INITIAL | par_over | `(?i:par_over)\b` | push(LINE) | `par_over <text>` … `end`: parallel paths drawn over each other. |
| INITIAL | and | `(?i:and)\b` | push(LINE) | `and <text>`: the next path of a `par`. |
| INITIAL | critical | `(?i:critical)\b` | push(LINE) | `critical <text>` … `option <text>` … `end`: a critical region and its options. |
| INITIAL | option | `(?i:option)\b` | push(LINE) | `option <text>`: the next option of a `critical` region. |
| INITIAL | break | `(?i:break)\b` | push(LINE) | `break <text>` … `end`: a part that ends the sequence. |
| LINE | restOfLine | `(?i:(?::?(?:no)?wrap:)?)(?:[^#\n;]\|#\w+;)*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | end | `(?i:end)\b` |  | `end`: closes a `box`, `loop`, `alt`, `rect` or other block. |
| INITIAL | left_of | `(?i:left of)\b` |  | `note left of A: …`: a note left of the participant. |
| INITIAL | right_of | `(?i:right of)\b` |  | `note right of A: …`: a note right of the participant. |
| INITIAL | links | `(?i:links)(?=[ \t]+[^/\\+()<>:\n,;\s-])` |  | `links A: {"label": "url"}`: menu links for a participant. |
| INITIAL | link | `(?i:link)(?=[ \t]+[^/\\+()<>:\n,;\s-])` |  | `link A: label @ url`: one menu link for a participant. |
| INITIAL | properties | `(?i:properties)(?=[ \t]+[^/\\+()<>:\n,;\s-])` |  | `properties A: {"key": "value"}`: properties for a participant. |
| INITIAL | details | `(?i:details)(?=[ \t]+[^/\\+()<>:\n,;\s-])` |  | `details A: <element id>`: menu data read from a page element. |
| INITIAL | over | `(?i:over)\b` |  | `note over A: …` or `note over A,B: …`: a note over one or two participants. |
| INITIAL | note | `(?i:note)\b` |  | `note left of A: …`, `note right of A: …`, `note over A,B: …`. |
| INITIAL | activate | `(?i:activate)\b` | push(ID) | `activate A`: starts an activation bar on the participant. |
| INITIAL | deactivate | `(?i:deactivate)\b` | push(ID) | `deactivate A`: ends the participant's last activation bar. |
| INITIAL | title | `(?i:title)\s(?:[^#\n;]\|#\w+;)+` |  | `title <text>`: the diagram title. |
| INITIAL | legacy_title | `(?i:title:)\s(?:[^#\n;]\|#\w+;)+` |  | `title: <text>`: the diagram title (older form). |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `(?i:accTitle)\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `(?i:accDescr)\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `(?i:accDescr)\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SD | `(?i:sequenceDiagram)\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | autonumber | `(?i:autonumber)\b` |  | `autonumber`, `autonumber <start> [<step>]`, `autonumber off`: numbers the messages. |
| INITIAL | off | `(?i:off)\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SEMI | `;` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ACTOR | `[^/\\+()<\->:\n,;]+(?:(?!-(?i:x)\|--(?i:x)\|-\)\|--\)\|-\\|\\\|-\\\|-\/\|-\/\/\|-\\|\/\|…` |  | A participant id in a message or note: anything up to an arrow, `+`, `-`, `:`, `,` or `;`; a `-` joins an id unless an arrow starts there (`A-B->>C` is from `A-B`). |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW | `->>` |  | `->>` solid line, arrowhead. |
| INITIAL | BIDIRECTIONAL_SOLID_ARROW | `<<->>` |  | `<<->>` solid line, arrowheads at both ends. |
| INITIAL | DOTTED_ARROW | `-->>` |  | `-->>` dotted line, arrowhead. |
| INITIAL | BIDIRECTIONAL_DOTTED_ARROW | `<<-->>` |  | `<<-->>` dotted line, arrowheads at both ends. |
| INITIAL | SOLID_OPEN_ARROW | `->` |  | `->` solid line, no arrowhead. |
| INITIAL | DOTTED_OPEN_ARROW | `-->` |  | `-->` dotted line, no arrowhead. |
| INITIAL | SOLID_CROSS | `-(?i:x)` |  | `-x` solid line, a cross at the end. |
| INITIAL | DOTTED_CROSS | `--(?i:x)` |  | `--x` dotted line, a cross at the end. |
| INITIAL | SOLID_POINT | `-\)` |  | `-)` solid line, an open arrow (async). |
| INITIAL | DOTTED_POINT | `--\)` |  | `--)` dotted line, an open arrow (async). |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_DOTTED | `--\\|\\` |  | Half arrows: `--\|\`, `--\|/`, `--\\`, `--//` and their reverses, dotted. |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_DOTTED | `--\\|\/` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_TOP_DOTTED | `--\\\\` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_DOTTED | `--\/\/` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE_DOTTED | `\/\\|--` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE_DOTTED | `\\\\|--` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE_DOTTED | `\/\/--` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE_DOTTED | `\\\\--` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_TOP | `-\\|\\` |  | Half arrows: `-\|\`, `-\|/`, `-\\`, `-//` and their reverses. |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM | `-\\|\/` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_TOP | `-\\\\` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM | `-\/\/` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE | `\/\\|-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SOLID_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE | `\\\\|-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_TOP_REVERSE | `\/\/-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STICK_ARROW_BOTTOM_REVERSE | `\\\\-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | TXT | `:(?i:(?:(?:no)?wrap:)?)(?:[^#\n;]\|#\w+;)*` |  | `: text` after a message or note; `wrap:` / `nowrap:` first sets wrapping. |
| INITIAL | PLUS | `\+` |  | `A->>+B`: activates `B`. |
| INITIAL | MINUS | `-` |  | `A->>-B`: deactivates `A`. |
| INITIAL | PARENS | `\(\)` |  | `A->>()B`: a central connection on that end. |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  |  |
| INITIAL | INVALID | `.` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{.*?\}%%`
